svg.text: 68 x 40 ft exterior floor plate / 2,720 sq ft gross enclosed / 3 bedrooms + 2 baths
CONCEPT ONLY / Original design: Homes project contributors / CC BY 4.0
Primary suite: 18 x 12 ft bedroom / 6 x 6 ft dressing / L-shaped bath with separate tub, shower, WC and dual vanity
Panels store in left door pocket and right window pocket. No panel stack blocks the walk-through.
Room labels show nominal planning zones; they are not measured net floor areas. Interior doors shown open.
No site orientation is assigned. Shore, landscape, drainage and structural details are conceptual.
